description:
Hushfeed v0.41.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

A polish release with no new patches. Morphe Manager's update screen shows what changed again, since every changelog heading now carries the date Manager looks for, and every patch description names the settings page its switches live on. Settings search keeps what you typed through a rotation, and the Feature Gate Lab looks like the rest of settings. On the video, the ring that arms a Follow or Like confirmation shows up on TikTok's red buttons, and automatic advance offers Keep going when it stops at its limit.

Validation: 1408 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 90 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
